identity_rules: A reachable user job is counted when static evidence proves a distinct actor, aggregate/state, completion, disclosure purpose, or downstream handoff boundary.
A shared HTTP route or shared page may support multiple targets when a query discriminator, permission envelope, aggregate and output contract prove distinct jobs.

An implemented but unreachable, shadowed, no-op, generated/test-only, infrastructure, or resolver-orphan surface remains classified and mapped in the route/page disposition register but is excluded from the accepted H/D/M denominator.
Split, regrouped, and merged targets do not mechanically inherit benchmark or no-credible-match credit.
